observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && ls -la ~/.openhands/profiles/ ~/.openhands/provider-connections/ 2>/dev/null; echo "=== isi profil ==="; for f in ~/.openhands/profiles/*.json ~/.openhands/provider-connections/*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "--- $f ---" && python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(open('$f'))
for k,v in d.items():
    if 'key' in k.lower() or 'token' in k.lower() or 'secret' in k.lower(): v='<hidden>'
    print(f'  {k}: {v}')
" 2>/dev/null; done
